Definition: from G2596 and a derivative of G1413; to exercise dominion against, i.e. oppress:--oppress.
BiblicalUsage: God anointed Jesus to heal all who were oppressed of the devil, while James asks the rich who oppress the poor and drag them before the judgment seats.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe oppression is the devil's work, and healing is God's answer to it.
